note: He fits the intent of the ICP and not its economics. Health is precisely the neglected area — a decade of undiagnosed breathing obstruction that he had simply pushed through — and he is going good-to-great rather than seeking rescue: physically active in a demanding job, 185 lb at 5'6", already swinging a kettlebell, wanting strength first with fat loss as a by-product. He clears the deconditioned exclusion comfortably. But he is an employed commercial diver, not a business owner or physician, and he is paid monthly with roughly $4,000 of free cash against $2,700 of imminent committed outgoings, having just funded surgery out of pocket. He was closed anyway, on a $100 deposit with $5,900 contingent on an insurance reimbursement. This is the same pattern the existing ICP notes flag — the buying population is wider than the stated ICP, and 'makes good money' keeps failing to predict who transacts.
